task: AUDIT: Vent LIS interface — unit handling in NDBC/ASOS weather collectors

findings.problem: Unit mismatch in weather_collector.py — NDBC data stored as m/s when it's actually knots
findings.impact: All NDBC wind speed data off by factor of 1.94384 (stored 5.1 m/s when actual is 10 knots)
findings.severity: HIGH — affects buoy-server.js calculations and race analytics

affected_files: mcp/buoy-server.js — reads wind_speed_kts correctly but source data wrong
regatta/wind.html — displays buoy data (depends on collector)

bug_details.issue: NDBC returns knots but code labels it as m/s
bug_details.asos_impact: ASOS correctly in m/s, but conversion applied uniformly

unit_conversions_found.collector_storage: Stores both as wind_speed_ms (WRONG for NDBC)

fix_required.option_1: Convert NDBC knots to m/s: wind_speed_m/s = data["wind_speed"] / 1.94384
fix_required.option_2: Store NDBC in native knots, convert only for InfluxDB output
fix_required.recommended: Option 2 — store native units, document conversion at storage layer

files_to_audit.regatta/wind.html: Check what units expected from API
files_to_audit.regatta/server.py: Any weather API endpoints or references

recommendations: 1. Fix weather_collector.py: handle NDBC and ASOS unit conversions separately
2. Add unit validation to buoy-server.js (verify kts consistency)
3. Document InfluxDB schema: which measurement fields are in which units
4. Add test case: fetch real NDBC data, verify units match buoy.wind_speed_knots
